name: internlink
description: InternLink — recruiter & intern talent marketplace. Monorepo.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @internlink/shared-types && npm run build -w @internlink/design-tokens
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @internlink/api && npm run build -w @internlink/web
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:rules && npm run deploy:hosting
